Use case: ads-marketing / photorealistic-natural. Asset type: MagicKeys customisable site example photograph for an Australian commercial property. Create a very high-quality bright daytime architectural photograph of a modern low-rise Australian commercial property with a properly engineered vehicle entrance: a large two-leaf dark grey vertical-bar double swing gate with sturdy fixed steel hinge posts and visible realistic hinge hardware, open in two physically believable arcs; in the separate neighbouring car-park lane a red-and-white striped boom gate with a real pivot motor cabinet, long straight arm and receiving support post. A clean pedestrian entrance next to the building. A few discrete CCTV dome or bullet cameras mounted sensibly above the entrance and on the building, aimed toward the access points. Physically plausible lane widths, gate heights, arm lengths and perspective. Landscaping, white sky with blue detail, natural Australian sun, bright polished colours, crisp steel textures, subtle shadows and high contrast without blown highlights. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, complete gates visible and in proportion, no cropped equipment. No people, no signage or text, no AI wording, no invented logos, no drones, no floating digital interfaces or futuristic fantasy hardware. This is a plausible architectural site concept for customising existing access and CCTV equipment.
